stories.title: Government shortlists seven contractors for 24 Sussex Drive renovation
stories.summary: Public Services and Procurement Canada has named seven contractor partnerships to renovate 24 Sussex Drive. The government has pledged $8.5 million toward the project and set a fundraising goal of $50 million to make the residence habitable again. The house has been empty for years.

stories.title: B.C. Supreme Court rules religious facilities may prohibit MAID
stories.summary: The B.C. Supreme Court ruled that religious health-care facilities can continue to prohibit medical assistance in dying on their premises. Patients seeking the procedure must transfer to other locations. The court upheld the existing exemption for religious institutions. The policy remains unchanged.
